##### Project general facts

Azizi Leily by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential tower that combines a streamlined volume with a wide, light-toned podium, creating a balanced modern aesthetic beside the creek. An elegant wave-like metal screen adds texture at the base, while the clean geometry of the tower is complemented by spacious balconies with glass railings. The building rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and four podium levels to fifteen residential floors and a rooftop with leisure areas.

The collection offers studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, together with penthouses with panoramic views of the creek and the skyline and premium retail units. Residents enjoy swimming pools for adults and children with a poolside terrace, a fully equipped fitness centre, a sauna, a steam room and a yoga area, while a cinema, a rooftop garden, an indoor multipurpose hall, indoor and outdoor children's play areas, lounges and accessible facilities complete the offer.

Interiors follow a contemporary style with an emphasis on light and comfort, combining high-quality finishes, open layouts and expansive glazing that floods the living spaces with natural light. Balconies frame views over the water and the city, extending each home outdoors. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Jaddaf is a culturally rich waterfront district along Dubai Creek, combining heritage, commerce and leisure. The Dubai Culture Village, the Al Jaddaf Waterfront promenade, luxury hotels such as Palazzo Versace and a growing choice of restaurants, cafes and parks give the area a calm, characterful atmosphere, with panoramic views across the creek towards the historic heart of the city and the modern skyline.

Al Khail Road, Sheikh Zayed Road and Dubai-Al Ain Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Creek metro station is close by. Dubai Festival City, Wafi Mall and Dubai Healthcare City are a short drive away, Dubai International Airport and the Dubai World Trade Centre are close by, and Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall are within comfortable reach.

Al Jaddaf is a freehold district open to international buyers and one of the most central waterfront addresses in Dubai. Proximity to Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and the main business districts attracts professionals and short-stay guests, supporting high occupancy. Creek views, metro access and competitive prices compared with neighbouring prime areas underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
